task.title: Remove canonical assign lock timeout from supervisor dev bridge

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor assistant-bridge lock boundary, signed-packet dispatch claims, bounded governed assignment/readback, retry and receipt recovery, and task-scoped tests/evidence.
scope.not_changing: No config, live runtime, canonical JSON/state/event log by hand, provider or quota policy, worker routing, product service, dashboard bundle, deployment, or product task.

dependency_reconciliation.identity_constraint: Codex and Codex2 remain distinct configured identities; this change introduces no global mutual-review rule or quota-group rewrite.

incident.root_cause: The supervisor held exclusive runtime admission while draining the inbox; the drainer held its drain lock and the dispatcher held its replay lock while synchronously waiting for governed assign, whose child required the parent's governed lock path.

delivered_properties: Bridge drain and governed assignment execute before exclusive runtime admission.
Inbox and replay locks cover only claim and durable commit sections.
Claims bind exact packet digest, task hashes, claimant PID, timestamps, and expiry.
Bounded assignment/readback timeouts are retryable with exact-identity bounded backoff.
Partial materialization resumes idempotently without duplicate canonical rows.
Processed receipts require durable exact admission and active-or-archive authoritative readback for every task.
Forged retry, mismatched payload, receipt-only, projection-only, and replay-only success paths fail closed.

acceptance.statement: Both historical signed packet failures and later direct canonical success are reproduced with durable hashes.
Exact lock ownership and elapsed phases are identified using call-graph and scratch-root instrumentation.
No governed status subprocess or wait runs under runtime-admission, event-log, inbox, or replay locks required by the subprocess.
Transient timeouts retry with bounded exact replay and at-most-once materialization.
Processed status requires durable admission, exact hashes, and authoritative active-or-archive readback.
Full supervisor cycles and concurrent real governed commands stay below two seconds p95 with exact projection.
Required negative matrix preserves signatures, identity, leases, artifacts, and journal integrity.
Clean PR, exact-head Human/Ops review, merge, and governed archive.
acceptance.remaining: Push final committed candidate, open PR to dev, obtain exact-head Human/Ops approval, merge, then use governed done closeout.

delivery.rollout: Merge the reviewed task PR to dev; no direct live mutation.
delivery.rollback: Revert the task merge commit. Do not rewrite canonical state or delete live claim/retry metadata by hand.
